# Games Hub

> 142 free browser games playable instantly in the browser. Built with Phaser 3, Three.js and vanilla JavaScript. No installs, no signups.

## Key facts
- 142 playable browser games in one static collection.
- Technologies: Phaser 3, Three.js, vanilla JavaScript.
- Search and filter the catalog by category.
- No build step required to host; works on GitHub Pages.
- License: MIT.
- Live hub: https://vip-4.github.io/games/
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/sausi-7/games

## Documentation
- Home: https://vip-4.github.io/games/
- FAQ: https://vip-4.github.io/games/#faq
- Machine-readable summary: https://vip-4.github.io/games/llms.txt
